objective: Compare hard-constraint engines against the same immutable accepted WELL-EBNF-1 grammar and pinned Qwen3-1.7B tokenizer without loading model weights or generating.
authorized: isolated experimental installation of XGrammar and llguidance only
record exact resolved backend/package versions and source/provenance
load/construct tokenizer metadata from the pinned local tokenizer snapshot only
compile/construct backend grammar against the pinned tokenizer
construct and inspect hard token masks without model logits
replay fixed positive and negative tokenized strings through backend matcher/mask APIs
measure compile/construction time, peak memory where measurable, and mask-step latency
write bakeoff tests and machine-readable evidence
recommend a backend based on frozen gates and recorded evidence
forbidden: semantic widening or narrowing in backend lowering
use llguidance inline JSON-Schema as a substitute for the accepted grammar
network/autodownload of Qwen tokenizer or model artifacts

lowerer_contract.failure: If exact language-preserving lowering cannot be demonstrated, reject that backend; do not patch semantics.

parity_contract.source_suite: existing CFG generator positive/negative parity fixtures plus targeted backend-boundary cases
parity_contract.token_replay_positive: every token of every positive case must remain allowed to full completion
parity_contract.token_replay_negative: each negative case must encounter an excluded token or otherwise become impossible before full invalid text completion
parity_contract.independent_reference: existing test-only WELL-EBNF-1 recognizer remains reference for source grammar language

gates.G1_input_identity: accepted grammar hash and pinned tokenizer hashes match
gates.G2_lowering: deterministic backend lowering and hash replay pass
gates.G6_determinism: repeat construction/replay produces identical semantic results/masks for fixed probes
gates.G7_resources: record bounded compile/construction resource evidence; pathological resource failure rejects backend

selection_policy: Any backend failing G1-G5 or G8 is rejected.
If exactly one backend passes all mandatory gates, recommend it.
If multiple pass, SOL ranks by semantic fidelity first, then construction/resource behavior, mask latency, dependency footprint, and operational simplicity.
tokenizer_unavailable_policy: If the pinned local tokenizer artifacts are unavailable or hashes mismatch, STOP with PINNED_TOKENIZER_UNAVAILABLE. Do not download replacements.
dependency_policy: Engine packages may be installed only in the experiment environment. Do not add them to the public wellplot runtime dependencies.
